title: one-change changelog entry (omnibase_core#987)
prompt:
Summarize the merged change below in at most two sentences for a changelog: what changed, then why. Name the pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the change text. Also name the ticket OMN-10351.

--- change 1 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #987) ---
feat(OMN-10351): add EnumFileZone for tiered QA gate classification (#987)
* feat(OMN-10351): add EnumFileZone for tiered QA gate classification

Introduces EnumFileZone (StrEnum) with six directory-role values:
production, test, config, generated, docs, build. Distinct from
EnumFileType which classifies by extension/format — a .py file is
PRODUCTION under src/ but TEST under tests/.

* feat(OMN-10355): implement file zone classifier (#994)

Pure function classify_path(Path) -> EnumFileZone with priority order:
generated > production > test > config > docs > build.
Resolves symlinks before classification. 8 unit tests covering all zones
and the symlink resolution case.

* feat(OMN-10354): add ModelZonePolicy for per-zone QA gate config (#995)

Frozen Pydantic model with zone:EnumFileZone, qa_depth:Literal, and
four bool gate fields (lint, test, review, security_scan). Stacked on
jonah/omn-10351-enum-file-zone.

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
